policy.detection: seven classes; RGB own labels, IR own labels; RGBT RGB reference. Clip to image for YOLO only; drop zero-intersection and identical detections with explicit log; do not choose between conflicting identity annotations.
policy.tracking: class-agnostic official test GT; COMBINED_SEQ over all sequences separately for RGB and IR coordinate references. All seven detector classes contribute; GT category=1 means object, not pedestrian.
policy.test: Original 30-sequence test fixed; never used as validation; official GT preserved byte-for-byte including empty RGB sequence.
policy.validation: Internal grouped holdout from original train; same split for RGB, IR and RGBT. See splits.json for fully specified construction.
policy.train_mot: No MOT training GT exported: ambiguous raw IDs require review before supervised ReID/association training. Detector training uses identity-free boxes.
policy.class_aware_mot: Not enabled: official GT has no semantic classes and DJI_0073_3 boxes differ from COCO; cannot assign labels by exact matching for all rows.
policy.weights: Existing M3OT one-class weights are not final seven-class models; new training required.
policy.parent_overlap: Official train/test share 8 parent clip names; official split preserved and overlap disclosed. Internal train/val parent groups are disjoint.
policy.model_construction: Use tools/build_vttiny_model.py to inject data channel contract; plain DetectionModel(ch=1) in the current user framework otherwise retains a default 3-channel router.
